item.description: Patrick O'Sullivan and Owen Murphy took the honours at the Carbery night navigaiton trial on Saturday night. item.title: Emergency services at the scene of Aughnacloy crash
item.description: Emergency services are currently at the scene of a crash in Aughnacloy, close to the Co Monaghan border. The Tullyvar Road is blocked in both directions following a road traffic collision. A statement issued by the PSNI to Northern Sound stated: "Road users are advised that the Tullyvar Road in Aughnacloy is currently blocked in both directions following a road traffic collision. Advertisement "Traffic is being diverted via the Favour Royal Road. Please avoid the area and seek alternative routes

item.title: €312,000 funding under Local Enhancement Programme
item.description: €312,000 has been allocated to Cavan and Monaghan under the Local Enhancement Programme 2026. Fianna Fáil Minister of State, Niamh Smyth welcomes the announcement that was made by the Minister for Rural Development, Dara Calleary. Nationally, the programme will provide funding of €7 million. Advertisement This funding will provide capital supports that are essential for many small community groups and organisations, particularly those who serve disadvantaged communities in rural and urban areas.

item.title: Free parking in Monaghan Town in place from today
item.description: Local councillor Raymond Aughey has welcomed free parking in Monaghan Town which is in place from today. Free parking will be available from 12 noon daily from today until Thursday the 1st of January. Cllr Aughey welcomed the annual initiative which he says entices people to shop local and support businesses. item.title: Locals urged to have their say on new biodiversity plan
item.description: Monaghan County Council is developing a new five year Biodiversity Action Plan to guide the protection and conservation of the county’s biodiversity. The draft plan outlines an ambitious five-year framework to protect, restore, and enhance the county’s rich and diverse natural environment. The plan proposes 50 targeted actions organised under 4 strategic themes. Advertisement Monaghan County Council is encouraging locals to share their thoughts on the draft action plan. item.title: Appeal issued over collision between cyclist and pedestrian in Enniskillen
item.description: Police in Enniskillen are appealing for witnesses and information following a collision involving a pedestrian and a cyclist on Friday, 5th December. Police received a report at around 6.40pm of a woman, who was walking on the footpath in the Wellington Road area, being knocked to the ground by a male cyclist. item.title: Increased funding needed for roads in Cavan/Monaghan
item.description: Aontú Senator Sarah O'Reilly has voiced her concerns over the worsening condition of roads in Cavan-Monaghan. Senator O'Reilly raised the issue in the Seanad with the Minister of State and warned that funding is nowhere near enough to tackle years of neglect. The local representative says local roads are so battered that people's stomachs turn at the thought of driving them. item.title: Status Orange wind warning issued locally
item.description: A orange wind warning has now been issued for Cavan and Monaghan. The warning which will run from 10am tomorrow morning until 9pm has been upgraded since being previously under a yellow warning. Met Éireann has forecast very strong to gale force winds, expected to become confined to west and northwest counties later in the day. Advertisement It said that debris and loose objects may be displaced and outdoor events could be impacted.
